ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, to measure the height of a building, at point A, which is 30 meters away from the base of the building at point O, the angle of elevation to the top of the building at point B is measured to be $\angle OAB = 65^\circ$. What is the height of this building?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, in the right-angled triangle $\triangle$ABO,\\
since $\angle$AOB$=90^\circ$ and $\angle$A$=65^\circ$ with AO$=30$m,\\
then $\tan 65^\circ = \frac{OB}{AO}$,\\
thus, OB$=30\cdot\tan 65^\circ$ meters.\\
Therefore, the answer is: $BO=\boxed{30\cdot\tan 65^\circ}$ meters.
